name: vertical_double_half_hitch
title: Vertical double half hitch
about: The double half hitch tied round an upright cord with a working cord that comes from the side: the working cord shows, so rows of them make blocks of its colour. Two half hitches, both turned the same way. Shown loose.

steps.caption: Hold the cord to be knotted on upright.
Take the working cord over the holding cord, round, and back under it.
Bring it across over its own standing part. That is one half hitch.
Take it over the holding cord again, beside the first hitch, and back under it.
Bring the end over its own crossing part and pull it snug against the first hitch: a double half hitch.
